data.name: Rustum
data.gender_notes: Rustum is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rustum is a heroic name of Persian origin, referring to a legendary warrior of great strength, featured in Islamic and Persian literature. The name Rustum carries the meaning “Strong Warrior, Hero” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Persian, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Rustum usually hope their child will grow to embody strong warrior, hero and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents courage, strength, and protection of the weak.
data.etymology: Rustum belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong Warrior, Hero.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rustum total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
